description: MN-01 is the District Transport Office for Imphal West, serving as a primary hub for motor vehicle administration in the capital of Manipur. It manages vehicle registrations, driving tests, and transport permits for residents within the western quadrant of the Imphal valley.

The MN-02 RTO serves as the District Transport Office for Churachandpur in Manipur. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit issuance for the southern district of the state.
address: District Transport Office, Tuibong, Churachandpur, Manipur

description: The MN-03 RTO is the District Transport Office (DTO) for the Kangpokpi district in Manipur. It is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and enforcement of transport regulations along the NH-39 corridor.
address: Ward No. 7, Near National Highway 39 (NH-39), Kangpokpi, Manipur

description: The MN-04 RTO serves the Thoubal district in Manipur, providing essential transport services under the state government's mandate. It is responsible for vehicle registration, the issuance of driving licenses, and the collection of road taxes to ensure road safety and legal compliance.

The MN-05 Regional Transport Office serves the Bishnupur district in Manipur, facilitating motor vehicle registrations and driving license issuances. It is a key administrative hub for transport services in the region, covering major areas like Moirang and Nambol.
address: District Transport Office, Bishnupur, Near Registrar Office, Bishnupur, Manipur

description: MN-06 is the official RTO code for the District Transport Office (DTO) in Imphal East, Manipur. This office handles vehicle registration, driver licensing, and transport permits for the eastern part of the capital region, including significant areas like Mantripukhri and Porompat.
address: District Transport Office (DTO), Near STPI, P.O. Mantripukhri, Imphal East, Manipur

description: MN-07 is the designated District Transport Office for Ukhrul, Manipur, handling motor vehicle registration and driver licensing services. Located in the Mini Secretariat, it serves the residents of the hilly eastern region near the Indo-Myanmar border. The office is responsible for revenue collection through road taxes and ensuring transport safety regulations across the district.
address: District Transport Office, West Block, Mini Secretariat, Ukhrul, Manipur

description: MN-08 represents the District Transport Office in Senapati, Manipur. It is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations within the Senapati district.
address: District Transport Office, Mini Secretariat Complex, Senapati, Manipur

description: MN-09 is the District Transport Office (DTO) for the Chandel district in Manipur. It provides essential services such as vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection for the district which borders Myanmar.
address: District Transport Office, Mini Secretariat Complex, Chandel, Manipur

description: MN-10 is the District Transport Office (DTO) for Jiribam district, established after the district reorganization in late 2016. It serves as a vital transport hub for vehicle registration and licensing on the Manipur-Assam border.
address: Office of the District Transport Officer, District Administrative Complex, Jiribam, Manipur
